title: Shrinking the differential defects of an open-site degreewise family
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $x\in U$ an open, and $P,Q$ cochain complexes of module sheaves on the slice site over $U$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with $P$ strictly perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let $W\subseteq U$ contain $x$, let $R_W$ restrict from $U$ to $W$, let $S_W$ be the termwise open module stalk functor at $x$ on $W$ [def-sc-open-module-stalk-functor], and let $T$ be that functor on $U$. Suppose $e:R_W\circ S_W\cong T$ is a natural isomorphism and $g_n:R_W(P)^n\to R_W(Q)^n$ are already defined component maps whose stalks satisfy all adjacent chain equations. There exist an affine $V\subseteq W$ containing $x$, its restriction $R_V$ from $U$ and stalk functor $S_V$, a natural isomorphism $e_V:R_V\circ S_V\cong T$, and components $k_n:R_V(P)^n\to R_V(Q)^n$ satisfying all adjacent chain equations, with $S_V(k_n)=(e_V)_P^n\,(e_P^{-1})^n\,S_W(g_n)\,e_Q^n\,((e_V)_Q^{-1})^n$ in categorical composition order. No perfectness or boundedness assumption is made on $Q$.

source.place: Tags 09RE (affine finite-presentation calculation) and 01CP (internal-Hom stalk comparison); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09RE and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01CP, read 2026-10-13

proof.text: For each n apply exists_open_stalk_retract_hom_eq to g n followed by d_Q and d_P followed by g (n+1). Functor.map_comp identifies the stalk equality with hcomm. The finite-free splitting is hP.2 n.

Induct on the finite support interval Finset.Icc a b from hP.1, intersecting the equation neighbourhoods. Restriction transitivity transports each equality to the intersection. Choose an affine open inside it using exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset. Restrict g and conjugate with the explicit restriction-composition isomorphism. Its complex-map commutativity proves the adjacent chain equations in the interval; outside the interval, the directly restricted source P.X n is zero and IsZero.eq_of_src proves them.

The source theorem uses exists_openStalk_restriction_transport to identify its constructed comparison with the canonical V comparison. It then proves the canonical conjugation formula by naturality. For arbitrary initial comparison e as in the node statement, take eV to be canonical eV followed by canonical eW inverse followed by e. Expanding component composition yields the stated formula by cancellation. The parent chain-map lift implements exactly this coordinate change.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_perfect_open_stalk_degreewise_shrink
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (x : X) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hP : IsStrictlyPerfect X U P)
    (W : X.Opens) (hxW : x ∈ W) (hWU : W ≤ U)
    (g : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (((SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hWU : W ⟶ U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P).X n ⟶
      (((SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hWU : W ⟶ U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q).X n)
    (hcomm : ∀ n : ℤ,
      (openModuleStalkFunctor X W ⟨x, hxW⟩).map (g n) ≫
        (((openModuleStalkFunctor X W ⟨x, hxW⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
            (homOfLE hWU : W ⟶ U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)).d n (n + 1) =
      (((openModuleStalkFunctor X W ⟨x, hxW⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
          (homOfLE hWU : W ⟶ U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)).d n (n + 1) ≫
        (openModuleStalkFunctor X W ⟨x, hxW⟩).map (g (n + 1))) :
    let e : (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
          (homOfLE hWU : W ⟶ U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
        (openModuleStalkFunctor X W ⟨x, hxW⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
        (openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) :=
      Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
        (openModuleStalkRestrictionComparison X U W hWU x hxU hxW) (.up ℤ)
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V) (_hV : IsAffineOpen V) (_hVW : V ≤ W) (hVU : V ≤ U),
      let R := (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hVU : V ⟶ U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
      let S := (openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
      let T := (openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
      let eV : R ⋙ S ≅ T := Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
        (openModuleStalkRestrictionComparison X U V hVU x hxU hxV) (.up ℤ)
      ∃ k : ∀ n : ℤ, (R.obj P).X n ⟶ (R.obj Q).X n,
        (∀ n : ℤ, k n ≫ (R.obj Q).d n (n + 1) =
          (R.obj P).d n (n + 1) ≫ k (n + 1)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, (openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩).map (k n) =
          (eV.app P).hom.f n ≫ (e.app P).inv.f n ≫
            (openModuleStalkFunctor X W ⟨x, hxW⟩).map (g n) ≫
              (e.app Q).hom.f n ≫ (eV.app Q).inv.f n)
